# The AO Audit — Answer Optimization

> The AO Audit is a free interactive Answer Optimization (AO) audit that scores
> how visible a business is to AI engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google
> AI Mode) and AI agents. Twenty-two checks across four pillars — Entity, Content,
> Code, Agents — returning a 0-100 AO Score and a prioritized fix list.
> Companion tool to the paid guide "Be the Answer: The AI-Search Authority
> Playbook." Updated July 2026.

## Core content

- [The AO Audit](https://aoaudit.com/): run the audit and get your AO Score
  with a scored, prioritized fix list.
- [Sample AO Report](https://aoaudit.com/sample-report.pdf): a real example of
  the full report, no email required.

## Key facts

- Answer Optimization (AO) is the practice of making a business the answer AI
  engines give: findable, understandable, trustworthy, and transactable to
  machines.
- The AO Score measures whether AI engines can find, understand, cite, and
  recommend a business, and whether AI agents can complete a booking or
  purchase with it.
- Industry studies find sites with clean structured data are cited up to 3.2x
  more often in AI answers.
- Businesses that are ambiguous or unstructured to machines are not penalized
  by AI engines - they are simply never mentioned.
